summary: Strip libass (and transitively freetype/fribidi/harfbuzz) out of the audio-only build.
markersNote: This patch's effect is DELETION — libass and transitively freetype, fribidi and harfbuzz are absent from the link — and absence has no string to grep for. It is asserted instead by the dt-needed category, which is the only honest way to check a patch whose entire content is removal.
